verses.text: Ha winhaj Belsasar sreyal Babilonia, ix yawtej mil heb' niwak yopisio winh t'a yol snación t'a jun niwan wael. Ha t'a jun wael chi', ix yuk' anh heb', ix yuk'an anh winh yet' heb'.

Wanxo sk'e anh t'a sjolom winh rey chi', ix schekan winh ik'chajkot kopa yet' uk'ab' nab'a oro, haton juntzanh yik'nakkot winhaj Nabucodonosor smam icham winh t'a templo t'a Jerusalén. Ha t'a yol juntzanh kopa yet' juntzanh uk'ab' ix b'at ik'chajkot chi', hata' ix yuk' anh winh yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum yet' pax masanil heb' ayoch yet' winh t'a wael chi'.
Masanil heb' ix cham yuj anh, ix yik'anchaanh sdiosal heb' nab'a oro, plata, bronce, hierro, te te' yet' k'een k'een.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix cheklaj jun k'ab' anima b'aj sakq'uinal yuj candil, ix och ijan stz'ib'anoch t'a sat pat chi'. Ayik ix yilan jun k'ab' stz'ib'an chi' winh rey,
sak ix aj sat winh yuj xiwelal. Ix luklonk'e yok winh, ix el wal yip winh.

Elanhchamel ix el yaw winh, ix yawtankot heb' naumel lolonel winh, heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' ajchum. Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ha mach syal yilan juntzanh tz'ib'ab'iloch chi', syalan t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, tz'ak'chajoch junok pichul púrpura t'ay, tz'ak'chajoch junok cadena oro t'a sjaj, tz'och t'a yoxil yajalil t'a in makb'en tik, xchi winh.
Masanil heb' jelan ayoch yopisio yak'an srazón winh rey chi', ix och heb' t'a yol jun cuarto, palta malaj wal junok heb' ix nachajel yuj tas syalelk'ochi.
Ix te xiw winhaj rey Belsasar chi', sak ix aj yilji sat winh. Haxo masanil heb' winh winak ayek' yet' winh ta', ix somchajpax sk'ool heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an ix reina, snun winh rey chi' yel yaw winh yet' pax heb' awtab'il, ix och ix t'a yol scuartoal b'aj ayoch q'uinh chi', ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ayokab'nhej opisio t'a junelnhej. Mokab' ak' pensar, mokab' ach sakb'ielpax yuj xiwelal,

yujto ha t'a yol a makb'en tik, ay jun winh syal snachajel yuj, ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'a winh. Ha t'a yol stiempoal winh a mam icham, a jun winh winak chi', ix sch'ox wal winh to ay spensar winh te wach', ay spensar winh sik'lab'il icha yik heb' Dios. Yuj chi', a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor a mam icham, a winh ix ak'anoch jun winh chi' yajalilok heb' ay spensar, heb' naumel lolonel, heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' ajchum.

Daniel sb'i jun winh chi', haxo winh a mam icham chi' ix ak'an skuch winh Beltsasar. Te ay sjelanil winh yet' tas yojtak, yik snachajel wayich yuj winh, syal snachajpaxel yuj winh tas syalelk'och junok lolonel to ajaltak snachajeli yet' sb'oan yaj junok tas to niwan yaji. Awtejkot winh an. Ha winh ol ak'an ojtakejel tas syalelk'och juntzanh tz'ib' t'a sat pat tik, xchi ix t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix awtaj winhaj Daniel chi', ix ik'chajb'at winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿A ach am tik tza kuch Daniel, aj Judá ik'b'ilkot preso yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor winh in mam icham?
Ix alchaj t'ayin tob' ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'ayach, tob' ay a pensar, jelan ach.

Yuj chi' ix ach wawtej. Ix wawtej masanil heb' winh jelan yet' heb' naumel lolonel, yik syawtej juntzanh lolonel heb' tz'ib'ab'iloch tik yet' yalan heb' t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, palta malaj wal junok heb' snachajel yuj tas syalelk'ochi.

Ix alchaj t'ayin tob' syal ak'an cheklajel lolonel ajaltak snachajeli. Yuj chi' ta syal awtan juntzanh lolonel tik, tzalan t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, ol ak'chajoch pichul púrpura t'ayach, ol ak'chajpaxoch junok cadena oro t'a a jaj, ol ach och t'a yoxil yajalil t'a yol in makb'en tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Daniel chi' icha tik: --Kanokab' a silab' chi' t'ayach mamin rey. Syal ak'an jun opisio chi' t'a junokxo, palta ol wawtej jun tz'ib' tik, ol walan t'ayach tas wal syalelk'och juntzanh lolonel tz'ib'ab'iloch t'a sat pat tik.
Mamin rey, ha Dios Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' ix ak'an yopisio winhaj Nabucodonosor a mam icham yet' sniwanil yelk'ochi, sb'inajnakil yet' stzikikial.

Yuj opisio ix ak'chaj chi' t'a winh, ix xiw masanil anima t'a junjun nación yet' t'a junjun ti'al, yujto niwan yelk'och winh rey chi' t'a yol sat heb'. Ha mach snib'ej winh schami, schamnhej, haxo mach malaj snib'ej winh schami, max miljichamok. Ay pax mach ix ik'jiel t'a yopisio yuj winh, ay pax mach ix ak'jioch t'a yopisio, hato ha' tas snib'ej sk'ool winh.
Palta a wal yik ix yik'anchaanh sb'a winh, ix ixtaxel sb'eyb'al winh. Ix ik'chajel winh t'a yopisio t'a reyal chi' yet' sniwanil yelk'ochi.

Ix pechchajel winh t'a skal heb' yetanimail, ix ochkan spensar winh icha spensar nok' nok'. Junnhej ix aj winh yet' nok' kaltakte'al b'uru. Ix sk'ux anh ank'ultak winh icha nok' wakax. Ix empax yal ak'wal t'a sniwanil winh, masanto ix yal snachajel yuj winh chajtil wal yaj Dios, Jun Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, yajal pax yaj t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha tz'ak'anoch heb' yajal to snib'ej syak'ochi.
Ha hachxo pax tik, mamin rey Belsasar, yixchikin ach winh, wach'chom ojtak tas ix uji chi', palta manh wal jab'ok tzik'em a b'a.

Palta yelxo ix ik'chaanh a b'a t'a yichanh Jun Yajalil satcha'anh. Ix ak'an ik'chajkot juntzanh kopa t'a a mexa yet' juntzanh uk'ab' yik stemplo Jun Yajal satcha'anh chi'. Ha t'a yol juntzanh chi' ix uk' wino yet' masanil heb' awtab'il uuj. Ix eyik'chaanh juntzanh Dios to max yal yilani, max yal yab'ani, malaj pax jab'ok tas yojtak. Manhok pax t'a Dios ix al wach' lolonel, ina a pax t'a yol sk'ab' ay a k 'inal, a pax snaan tas tza k'ulej.
Yuj chi' ix yak'kot Dios jun k'ab' ix tz'ib'an juntzanh lolonel tik,
MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPARSIN.
Ha juntzanh tik icha tik syalelk'ochi: MENE: Toxo ix sb'is Dios jaye' k'u ayachto och t'a opisio, toxo ix sch'ox slajwub'.
TEKEL: Toxo ix ach echtaj t'a yol echlab', manh tz'akanok alil.
PERES: Ha a makb'en, wan spojchajb'ati, ix ak'chajoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' Medo yet' heb' Persa, xchi winhaj Daniel chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winhaj rey Belsasar chi' ak'chajoch pichul púrpura t'a winhaj Daniel chi'. Ix ak'chajoch jun cadena nab'a oro t'a sjaj winh. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a masanil anima to ha t'a jun rato chi', ix ochkan winhaj Daniel chi' t'a yoxil yajalil t'a yol smakb'en.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix miljicham winhaj Belsasar sreyal heb' caldeo chi'.
Haxo winhaj Darío aj Media ix yak'och sb'a yajalil sk'exulok winh. 62 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Darío chi'.
